description: Lu Meng, composed chinese general in the supplied pixel art style. A silver helmet with a white plume, a long white cape, grey armor with a red sash, dark boots. He holds a long spear with a silver leaf-shaped blade
face: A steady face with a short dark beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the silver helmet with the white plume, the long white cape with a red belt covering the back, the spear at his right side.
guard_action: both hands take the spear and bring it to a ready angle at the right side, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Spearman fighting guard, spear held in both hands, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the whole upper body winds far to the right with the spear held level; frames 7-8 the spear swings around from the side to the front in a wide flat arc; frames 9-11 hold in front. The spear travels sideways, not a thrust. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: High downward thrust. Frames 1-5 the rear hand lifts the spear to chest height; frames 6-8 a step and a thrust angled down from shoulder height; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: VERTICAL overhead spear strike. Frames 3-6 both hands raise the spear straight up above the head, pointing at the sky; frames 7-8 it is brought down from above onto the target; frames 9-11 hold with the tip low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s4: Hidden low lunge. Frames 1-6 the spear is hidden low beside the body and he crouches; frame 8 one long flat lunge that stays low; frames 9-12 hold the low reach. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → b2, 전법 s4. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
